comment: I have never in my entire academic career had a teacher as amazing as Professor Talbott. He is the most genuine person I have ever met and truly embodies everything that I hope to become. He cares so much for his students and tries to teach everyone to be as kind to each other as possible.

Cares a lot about his students. Taught me a lot about public speaking (really did not think that was possible, but he did!) Take him if possible. You won't be aware that you learned anything from him until you start giving speeches in class. Harsh grader on writing assignments, but will almost always give you an A+/A on speaking

One of the most impressive and inspiring individuals I have ever met. Extremely compassionate and caring. I came out of the class such an improved speaker and writer, as we spent class time actually practicing skills rather than completing trivial assignments like I've heard in other bcomm classes. Don't take bcomm with anyone else.

Visiting professor from Vanderbilt. Very bright guy who emphasizes on being empathetic and how successful one can be by seeing things from others' perspectives. Bus Com is a lot of work for half-credit regardless on who is teaching, but at least prof Talbott makes it fun and enjoyable. Great professor
